name: GENL EL. CO.  DL -,06
summary: GE Aerospace is a prominent American aviation enterprise specializing in manufacturing and supplying jet and turboprop engines and integrated systems for commercial, military, business, and general aviation, organized into Commercial Engines & Services and Defense & Propulsion Technologies segments. Based in Evendale, Ohio, the company traces its roots to its 1878 founding by Thomas Alva Edison.
